name: Wiki Page History
description: Every wiki page with its revisions over time, colored by wiki, kind of save, the page's status (deleted or never deleted) or any label, filtered by wiki, username, name and the time range, and one page's edit history in the range read as a wiki shows it: each revision a diff against the one before, by which username and IP prefix, with a link to its line and the administrator's deletes in place.

accepts.means: the record on line <n>: a page of pages.jsonl opened with its history, a revision of revisions.jsonl shown in its page's history, a save, delete or request of events.jsonl at its place in the page's history (or by itself when no page holds it), a username of labels.jsonl with its pages

units.means: one wiki page, such as dse/StartSeite, with its whole edit history and delete events

records.name: page
records.one: one wiki page of pages.jsonl with its revisions and delete events

fields.name: deletes
fields.how: the delete events whose page_key is the page's

fields.name: first and last write
fields.how: read as UTC seconds for the time axis

fields.name: status
fields.from: the page's delete events in events.jsonl
fields.how: deleted when at least one delete event names the page, else never deleted

records.name: revision
records.one: one stored revision of a page in revisions.jsonl

fields.name: diff
fields.from: this revision's body and the previous revision's body
fields.how: compared line by line with the changed characters of paired lines marked and unchanged runs shortened

fields.name: base
fields.from: seq, n_revs_before and the page's delete events
fields.how: prev against the revision before, new for a page's first revision, deleted against an empty page after a delete, withheld when the corpus holds no earlier revision

fields.name: admin
fields.from: label and the actor_label of delete events
fields.how: true when the username is one that deleted pages

fields.name: time
fields.how: read as UTC seconds for the time axis and shown in UTC

fields.name: save
fields.from: seq, n_revs_before and the page's delete events
fields.how: New page for a page's first revision, Edit against the revision before, After a delete against an empty page, First stored when the corpus holds no earlier revision

records.name: request
records.one: one request event of events.jsonl shown in a page's history

fields.name: page
fields.how: the page the id or keywords in the request URL name

records.name: username
records.one: one username of labels.jsonl with its pages

fields.name: edits
fields.how: the username's revisions on each of its pages

fields.name: deletes
fields.how: the delete events whose actor_label is the username
